definitionZh: CSS财产令规定了在弹性容器或网格容器中放置物品的命令。 容器中的物品按升序值排序,然后按其源代码顺序排序。 未给出明确顺序值的项目,指定默认值为0。
sourceDefinition: The order CSS property sets the order to lay out an item in a flex or grid container. Items in a container are sorted by ascending order value and then by their source code order. Items not given an explicit order value are assigned the default value of 0.
